speaker: Doctor

The normal liver biopsy is unexpected given the significant cholestatic pattern (high ALP, high bilirubin) and the Courvoisier sign (enlarged gallbladder), which strongly points to a mechanical obstruction rather than parenchymal liver disease. text: RESULTS: MRCP: Dilatation of the common bile duct with an abrupt cutoff at the level of the ampulla of Vater. No filling defects visualized within the biliary tree.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRCP findings of a distal common bile duct obstruction with an abrupt cutoff at the ampulla of Vater, combined with painless jaundice, weight loss, and Courvoisier gallbladder, are diagnostic of a periampullary or pancreatic head malignancy despite the earlier normal CT.
